narr: Thunderstorms moved across the western Florida panhandle and produced damaging winds.
ev: Law enforcement reported flooding at the intersection of L and Garden streets with vehicles stalled in the water.
Numerous flooded intersections reported in Pensacola, FL. Intersections include Marcus and Texar, Airport and Cobble View, 9th and College, Garden and Devillers, and D and Cervantes.
